Script 1 · “Stop trying to be fearless”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Stop trying to be fearless. The best performers I know never are.”

Body

“Fear isn’t the thing stopping you. Running from it is. When you learn to move toward your edges, fear becomes energy. That’s the idea behind my book, Fearvana, and it’s what I teach athletes and entrepreneurs.”

CTA

“I’m running a free 60-minute masterclass called Fear Into Fuel. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: talking to camera outdoors, cold-weather gear if you have it, on-screen text “fearless” crossed out.

Script 2 · “The 60 seconds before”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“What you do in the 60 seconds before a big moment decides a lot.”

Body

“Before a race, a pitch or a hard decision, most people let the nerves run the show. A simple routine changes that: notice the fear, name it, and point it at the task. That’s a skill, and you can train it.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through the full routine in my free live masterclass. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to a countdown graphic “60s” in red.

Script 3 · “Love the process”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“You hit the goal. So why doesn’t it feel like you thought it would?”

Body

“A lot of driven people chase the next result and never enjoy the road. Performing at your best and loving the process aren’t opposites. When fear becomes fuel, the hard parts start to feel like the point.”

CTA

“Join me for Fear Into Fuel, a free 60-minute class for athletes and entrepreneurs. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, B-roll of training or travel footage from your own content.
